# Vendored PICG (PCG-AI) core

- **Source:** https://github.com/DJ-Huang/PCG-AI (PICG — Procedural Intelligent Content Generation)
- **Commit:** `d10074f` (`Merge pull request #32 from DJ-Huang/feat/22-custom-function-schema`),
  pcg-core 0.1.2, vendored 2026-09-28
- **License:** Apache-2.0 — full text in `pcg-core/LICENSE` (copied from the upstream root LICENSE).

| Path | From | License |
|------|------|---------|
| `pcg-core/include/`, `pcg-core/src/` | `pcg-core/include`, `pcg-core/src` | Apache-2.0 |
| `pcg-core/node-manifest.json` | `schema/node-manifest.json` (node types, pins, properties) | Apache-2.0 |
| `CDT/include/` | `pcg-core/third_party/CDT` submodule @ `7bd85e4` (header-only use) | MPL-2.0, `CDT/LICENSE` |
| `nlohmann/nlohmann/json.hpp`, `json_fwd.hpp` | nlohmann/json `v3.11.3` single_include (upstream's pinned FetchContent tag) | MIT, `nlohmann/LICENSE.MIT` |

Not vendored: the Web editor, pcg-server, Unity plugin, FBX exporter,
examples (one test fixture excepted: `test/fixtures/spiral-staircase.pcg`,
Apache-2.0), and `src/blocks/blocks.cpp` (not in upstream's build).

## Local patches (search for `NexusMMOEngine`)

1. **Assimp is optional.** Upstream links Assimp (fetched as a source
   tarball by CMake) only to import mesh files (`ImportMesh`, reference
   reconstruction's embedded textures). Engine assets are procedural, and
   pulling a CMake-built Assimp into `npm install` would break the repo's
   "only a C++17 compiler" addon rule. `src/elements/assembly_algorithms.cpp`
   and `src/elements/oriented_sdf_surface.cpp` wrap their Assimp code in
   `#if PCG_WITH_ASSIMP`; with it off (binding.gyp sets `PCG_WITH_ASSIMP=0`)
   those nodes fail the cook with "needs a build with Assimp".
2. **The embedded node manifest is split.** Upstream's CMake embeds
   `node-manifest.json` (~1 MB) as one raw string literal, which MSVC
   rejects (C2026, ~16 KB per literal). `../generated/node_manifest_embedded.hpp`
   is generated by `../scripts/gen-manifest-header.mjs` as an array of
   pieces, and `src/elements/node_contracts.cpp` joins them before parsing.

## Updating

Replace `pcg-core/include`, `pcg-core/src` and `pcg-core/node-manifest.json`
from the new upstream commit; re-apply the two patches above; refresh the
source list in `../binding.gyp` from upstream's `pcg-core/CMakeLists.txt`
(`PCG_CORE_SOURCES`); run `node scripts/gen-manifest-header.mjs`; update the
commit above; `npm test` in this package.
